title: device_object
description: Device properties collected by [Customer.io SDKs](/integrations/sdk/) unless `autoTrackDeviceAttributes` is disabled. You can use these properties in segments and Liquid.

device_object_common.description: Device information common to the v1 and v2 APIs.

last_used.description: The `timestamp` when you last identified this device. If you don't pass a timestamp when you add or update a device, we use the time of the request itself. Our SDKs identify a device when a person launches their app.

attributes.description: Attributes that you can reference to segment your audience—like a person's attributes, but specific to a device. These can be either the attributes defined below or custom key-value attributes.

device_os.description: The operating system, including the version, on the device.

device_model.description: The model of the device a person uses.

app_version.description: The version of your app that a customer uses. You might target app versions to let people know when they need to update, or expose them to new features when they do.

cio_sdk_version.description: The version of the Customer.io SDK in the app.

_last_status.description: The delivery status of the last message sent to the device—sent, bounced, or suppressed. An empty string indicates that that the device hasn't received a push yet.

device_locale.description: The device's [IETF language code](/journeys/channels/localization/getting-started/#supported-languages), such as `en-MX` or `es-ES`.

push_enabled.description: If `"true"`, the device is opted-in and can receive push notifications.

additionalProperties.description: Custom properties that you want to associate with the device.
